ops.title: Land the payload-build diagnostic amendment (boot ID, vmstat oom_kill, failed-exec cgroup) as an isolated PR
ops.description:
Commits 7267d96 and 77c9df1 on origin/yasyf/producer-diagnostics, on top of eb755ab (merged in v0.9.0). Reviewed by one astra finder; both P2 findings were fixed in 77c9df1. It was held out of v0.9.0 because it changes plugins.sh for apt.payload renders, which moves the payload tools fingerprint.

What it adds:
- bootId then/now, sameBoot and countersResetAfterFailedExec
- /proc/vmstat oom_kill
- the failed verify exec's own cgroup, read only on the same boot

Rebase onto main, open a fresh PR, and rebuild the payload afterwards.

ops.text: A PR from main carrying 7267d96+77c9df1 (rebased) is green in CI
diagnose_linux_test.go exact-JSON cases pass, including changed-boot and recreated-cgroup rows
No-payload renders stay byte-identical to the ddfe484 goldens
